Title

Hello, I'm Jack!

I'm currently an AI Solutions Developer at Wesco and a recent Penn State graduate with a B.S. in Enterprise Technology Integration and a minor in Data Science. I enjoy figuring out how new technologies work and finding innovative ways to use them.

How I Got Here

Curiosity, Experimentation, and Learning by doing.

My first real exposure to the tech world came when I was 15 and built my own computer. I was excited to see what it could do, so I started using different programs to buy limited-edition sneakers online. Watching automation work in real time made me curious about what was happening behind the scenes. That was when I started learning to code and paying closer attention to the business side of what I was doing. Between the ages of 16 and 20, I ran my own LLC and learned how to manage the day-to-day responsibilities of a growing business that reached six figures in revenue in multiple years.

In college, that curiosity led me into crypto and NFTs just as the space started gaining traction in 2021. I was drawn to how quickly the technology and market were changing. I spent a lot of time trading, learning the space, and sharing what I knew with my community. It taught me how to learn quickly, explain unfamiliar ideas, and adjust when things changed. When the market cooled, I knew it was time to step back and put my energy into my education. Today, I continue looking for ways to apply what I've learned to the new fast paced spaces of AI and Web3.

Outside the Editor

When I'm not working or coding, you can find me:

  • Running
  • Weightlifting
  • Golfing
  • Traveling

Thanks for learning a little about my journey. If you'd like to talk about my experience or what I'm building, connect with me on LinkedIn or email me at jackpastor22@gmail.com.
